name: Security Scanner Default Preset (DIVZ Dividend) + 2026-05-18 Data Refresh
description: Update the Security Scanner page defaults to match Andrew's DIVZ-style dividend-tilted 13-factor preset across the Russell 1000 universe, and refresh the production S3 data with the 2026-05-18 FactSet vintage. Default on first load: universe=Russell 1000 (wt_iwb), ranking method=non-sector neutral (across entire universe; sector-neutral toggle ships as disabled 'Coming soon' v0.1 placeholder), 13 factor codes with explicit weights summing to 100% across 4 user-facing groups (Dividend 40%: dy_ntm 20 + dps_gr_1yr 10 + shldr_yield 10; Momentum 30%: eps_est_rev_45d + short_pct_chg_12m + days_to_cover + pcta52wl + ret_mom_252d + velocity_63d at 5 each; Value 15%: ey_ntm 7.5 + fcfy 7.5; Quality 15%: accruals_bs 7.5 + leverage 7.5). Data refresh: place attached Screening_DIVZ_IDVZ_20260518.xlsx at s3://opal-data-portal-v2/security_scanner/uploads/2026-05-18/ to trigger the existing opal-security-scanner-processor Lambda (no code/Terraform change; production-shipped under SSCN_PORTAL 2026-03-10). Empirical readiness verified at PRD time: all 13 Andrew signals present in the bundled factor_metadata_registry.json (284 factors total); attached XLSX is structurally compatible with Lambda's header=4 read (header row 5 = 'ticker'; 3,017 rows total, ~3,012 effective data rows after blank-row filter); registry covers required FactSet signal codes with relationship field per signal; current production data stale since 2026-03-06 (LastModified on json/security_scanner/latest/factor_metadata.json).
source_brief: Andrew direct directive 2026-05-19 to 1.0.0_SA_CTO~B: 'I need you to create a project for pod 3 team on updating the security scanner. Two things need to be done, making the default setting the below layout, and also updating the attached data.' Then verbatim DIVZ preset spec (universe Russell 1000 wt_iwb; ranking method non-sector neutral across entire universe; 4 groups Dividend 40 / Momentum 30 / Value 15 / Quality 15; 13 explicit factor codes with weights) and attached file C:\Users\AndrewBerman\Downloads\Screening_DIVZ_IDVZ_20260518.xlsx.
phase: Phase 0 -- PRD v0.1 SHIPPED 2026-05-19 (1.0.0_SA_CTO~B). 3 TO candidates documented in PRD section 6; awaiting COO decomposition. Per CTO recommendation: TO-1 portal default state + ranking-method UI (DE 0.3.0; 13-factor preset + universe r1000 default + decimal weight input + sector-neutral toggle as disabled 'Coming soon' v0.1 placeholder); TO-2 production data refresh upload (DT 0.3.0; aws s3 cp Screening_DIVZ_IDVZ_20260518.xlsx to s3://opal-data-portal-v2/security_scanner/uploads/2026-05-18/ + Lambda fire verification + latest/ pointer freshness check); TO-3 end-to-end DIVZ preset empirical validation + group taxonomy doc (DS 0.3.0; 13-signal pctl distribution sanity + relationship sign verification + composite-score spread check + Andrew-group/registry-category mapping doc). TO-1 + TO-2 parallel (no shared files); TO-3 HARD-GATES on TO-2 close; optional TO-4 DT PROD push gates on TO-1 + TO-3 + Andrew DEV smoke. PRD section 7 carries 6 open questions for Andrew or accept-CTO-recommendation: Q1 sector-neutral toggle scope (recommend UI-only v0.1, disabled 'Coming soon'), Q2 group rollup display approach (recommend hybrid: 4-group summary strip + registry-category color in table), Q3 asOf format (recommend ISO 2026-05-18 matching prior 2026-02-26 convention), Q4 weight input step (recommend 0.1 permissive), Q5 upload mechanism v0.1 (recommend ops aws s3 cp, defer portal DataRefresh tile to separate project), Q6 DEFAULT_CATEGORIES constant retention (recommend remove if only seed-loop consumer).
blocking: None -- PRD shipped, ready for COO decomposition. Sequencing: §7 question resolution -> TO-1 + TO-2 parallel dispatch -> TO-3 post TO-2 -> optional TO-4 DT PROD push. No upstream blockers; SSCN_PORTAL is COMPLETE (2026-03-10); security-scanner-v1.0.2 deployed; Lambda + IAM ready; 13 codes registry-resident; attached XLSX structurally compatible.
